purpose: Candidate retrieval, scoped feature lookup, and concept-graph membership. LLM review decides identity and applicability.

object.definition: The action domain is $[0,1]^d$. The Matern kernel $k=k_{\nu,\ell}$ is public, with smoothness $\nu>0$, length scale $\ell>0$, and $k(x,x)=1$. The environment fixes all reward functions before interaction: $$f_t\in\mathcal H_k,\qquad \|f_t\|_{\mathcal H_k}\le B\quad(t=1,\ldots,T).$$ $$\sum_{t=2}^{T}\|f_t-f_{t-1}\|_\infty\le V_\infty,\qquad \|g\|_\infty=\sup_{x\in[0,1]^d}|g(x)|.$$

operation.display_label_zh: Scalar reward of the selected action

feedback_quality.noise: z_t iid N(0,sigma^2), independent of algorithm

operation.query_signature: Choose $x_t\in[0,1]^d$ and then receive one noisy value at that point: $$Y_t=f_t(x_t)+Z_t,\qquad Z_t\overset{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2).$$. Noise is independent across rounds and independent of the algorithm; only the actual action point is observed. Causal randomized policies are allowed and $d,T,k,B,\sigma$ is public. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.
